name: Thoth
body:
Known as the First Scribe, the Great Arbiter, and the Keeper of Time, Thoth invented writing and the first calendar, oversaw the cycles of the moon, and because of his great wisdom, was the chosen arbiter to settle disputes among the gods. Thoth taught that the quest for knowledge was the greatest endeavor his followers could undertake.

Time

Granted Powers: You can slow, speed up, and even stop time.

Skip Ahead (Su)

You can periodically skip tiny moments ahead in time. When you prepare your spells for the day, roll a d4. For the next 24 hours, when you roll for initiative, you can add the result of your d4 roll to your total as a sacred bonus. (This does not require an action.)

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Extend Time (Ex)

At 8th level, you gain Extend Spell as a bonus feat. Once per day at 8th level, you can apply this feat to a spell without using up a spell slot one level higher.

You can cast a spell in this manner an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-deja vu, 2nd-surmount affliction, 3rd-sands of time, 4th-haste, 5ththreefold aspect, 6th-getaway, 7th-elude time, 8th-retrocognition, 9th-time stop.
